description_en: Revokes a client certificate or a server certificate issued by a private certificate authority (CA)
description_zh: 吊销某个客户端证书或服务端证书
name: CreateRevokeClientCertificate

parameters.description_en:
The unique identifier of the client or server certificate to revoke.

> Call [ListClientCertificate](~~465990~~) to query the unique identifiers of all client and server certificates.
parameters.description_zh:
要吊销的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。


> 您可以调用[ListClientCertificate](~~465990~~)查询所有客户端与服务端证书的唯一识别码。
